answer: The anti-Sybil check is sports club membership across twenty check-ins verified by oracle cross-checks. Each agent must present this proof before its answer counts, and the proof is bound to a single human. When the same proof shows up twice, the account is rate-limited to one action per hour, which makes sockpuppets expensive. A whisper proves the human showed up, a atlas proves the work is real, and a tundra proves the record is clean.
